_comment: 422 example — well-formed and fully populated, but requested_for does not correlate to any active reconciled sys_user (e.g. the identity has not synced yet, or the correlation id has a typo). resolveSubject() also refuses on the OPPOSITE failure mode -- more than one active user sharing the same correlation_id -- rather than silently picking the first match; see atf-sam-negative-unresolved-subject.xml for both cases.
justification: Same shape as a valid push -- the correlation id is the only thing wrong.
